drafts.body:
DRAFT - NOT FILED. File only after the brand owner approves it and has signed a Letter of Authorisation.

Hello Cloudflare Pages,

hxxps://moonwelldefi[.]pages[.]dev/ (172.66.47.24, 172.66.44.232) is hosted on your platform and impersonates Moonwell (official: hxxps://moonwell[.]fi).

- TLS certificate issued 2026-10-08 (Certificate Transparency)

- Page title resembles the official title (100%)

- Drainer-style JS: obfuscated-js(29977 _0x identifiers)
- Lure text: rewards
- Resolves to 172.66.47.24, 172.66.44.232
- Page title: "Moonwell - Lending made simple"

Please take the content down under your acceptable use policy.
